recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: open source communities wondering what agents mean for their craft
programmers still wrangling memory at the bit level
questions about wisdom in an age of generated answers
San Francisco fog lifting into a mostly clear autumn night
thirteen degrees and a light wind through the bay at equinox
agents spun up from a pocket, shipping by sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Drift through a foggy terminal catching glowing code fragments before wind scatters them into wrong compile paths.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to steer your collector orb
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each caught fragment adds a satisfying line to a live shader that blooms on screen
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: autumn gusts multiply fragment speed and spawn forked duplicates you must avoid
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe on fog-gray, SF bay at dusk

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap commits in rhythm to keep an open-source repo alive while agent forks threaten to overwrite main.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap on beat markers sliding down lanes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: perfect streaks unlock vintage commit messages as fleeting easter eggs
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tempo accelerates and merge-conflict hazards appear off-beat
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout git graph with hand-stamped labels

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous shipping route from phone shortcut to sunrise dock, rerouting around sleeping agents on the path.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace and hold to commit the route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: sunrise timer creates a dramatic 60-second finish line as the sky brightens
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: agents wake and patrol, forcing mid-stroke path redraws
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor dawn over San Francisco bay

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick wisdom-or-noise thought bubbles into sorted bins before the screen fills with generated platitudes.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to flick bubbles toward left or right bins
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: correct sorts crystallize into brief haiku fragments that stack at the top
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: bubbles gain weight and bounce unpredictably as the pile grows denser
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: frosted glass bubbles on autumn amber gradient
